in_marathi.name: Devakeenandan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's (Deva) Compassionate (Keena) One (Ananda)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devakeenandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devakeenandan is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘deva’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘keen’ meaning ‘compassionate’. This name signifies one who embodies the divine compassion of the gods. In Hindu mythology, there are several deities associated with compassion and kindness, such as Lord Ganesha and Lord Ayyappan. Devakeenandan is a name that invokes these qualities in the one who bears it.
